prompt: Animate this handcrafted cut-paper canoe crossing the calm lagoon at dawn. The single distant paddler makes one slow natural paddle stroke; the plain wooden paddle remains clearly visible and creates a gentle wake. The canoe glides smoothly left to right while the indistinct covered bundles stay low, stable and impossible to count as specific cargo. Add subtle mist, layered-paper parallax and a slow tracking camera. Preserve the canoe, paddler, bundles, water and distant huts without morphing. No new people, no visible salt blocks, no text, labels, logos, market, destination, motor, dramatic waves, camera shake, abrupt cuts or fast zoom.
